summary: PEDEVCO Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a routine amendment to its existing credit agreement with Citibank, N.A. The Third Amendment increased the borrowing base and elected commitment from $120 million to $125 million. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation is involved. The filing is a standard update to the company's credit facility terms with no change in control or transformative event. The next scheduled borrowing base redetermination is around July 1, 2026.
